title: 第350章 玄炼坊宋云启
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“站住！”

内城入口，一名守卫拦住一个正要入城之人。

“怎么了道友？”那人身穿古黄色长袍，头戴一顶黄色斗笠，闻言立刻朝守卫走去。

“怎么了？鬼鬼祟祟，戴着斗笠，一看你就不是什么好人，把斗笠给我摘了！不然马上把你抓起来审问。”

守卫放出神识打量了一下，发现此人不过练气三层的修为，明显不是那个‘韩贼’。

但是好不容易被调到这里，不行使一下手中权力，这个守卫岂不是白当了？

“咳咳，大哥你误会了，我不是什么坏人，只是有些仇家，不想被人认出来而已。”黄袍男子闻言，立刻一副讨好的神情。

“哼！我管你什么仇家，赶紧把斗笠摘下……”守卫脸色一沉，拿出了自己练气十层的威压。

但他话没说完，就突然哈哈大笑起来，“兄弟你早这样，不就没事了吗，你看这搞的多尴尬啊。”

“没事没事，都怪在下不识趣，这点灵石，您拿去买酒喝。”韩林将一个储物袋，塞进对方手里。

“好好好，兄弟，我叫陈启，以后遇到麻烦你报我名字！练气七层以下，我替你收拾了。”守卫朝着储物袋看了一眼，当看到里面足足有五百颗下品灵石时，更是笑得合不拢嘴。

“要得要得，多谢陈启大哥，那我就先进去了？”韩林见状，赔笑着说道。

“去吧去吧。”陈启挥了挥手，就坐在石凳上，拿起储物袋喜滋滋地翻看起来。

片刻后，内城贸易广场。

此时天色尚早，但贸易广场还是如往常一般的热闹，韩林微微顿足，就朝北边一家挂着“玄炼坊”招牌的铺子走去。

这铺子不像其他商铺那样摆满货品，里面倒像是一间会客的茶室，而且空荡荡的一个人也没有。

韩林进门四顾了一眼后喊道：“有人吗？”

话音落下，旁边的房间内响起一阵脚步声，紧接着，一个年过七旬的老者从侧屋内走了出来。

他盯着韩林看了眼，当发现韩林竟只有练气三层修为时，眉头顿时皱了起来，“你有事？”

“你就是宋云启道友吧？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Stop!"

At the entrance to the inner city, a guard stopped a person who was about to enter the city.

"What's wrong, fellow Taoist?" The man was wearing an ancient yellow robe and a yellow bamboo hat. Hearing the words, he immediately walked towards the guard.

"What's wrong? You're sneaky and wearing a hat. It looks like you're not a good person. Take off the hat for me! Otherwise, I'll arrest you immediately for interrogation."

The guard used his spiritual consciousness to take a look and found that this person was only at the third level of Qi training and was obviously not the 'Korean thief'.

But after finally being transferred here, if I don't exercise my power, wouldn't my job as a guard be in vain?

"Ahem, brother, you misunderstood. I'm not a bad person, I just have some enemies and don't want to be recognized." Hearing this, the man in yellow robe immediately looked fawning.

"Hmph! I don't care who your enemy is, just take off the hat quickly..." The guard's face darkened, and he took out the tenth level of Qi training.

But before he could finish his words, he suddenly burst into laughter, "Brother, if you had done this earlier, wouldn't it be fine? Look at how embarrassing this is."

"It's okay, it's all my fault for being ignorant. You can use this spiritual stone to buy some wine." Han Lin put a storage bag into the other person's hand.

"Okay, okay, brother, my name is Chen Qi. If you encounter any trouble in the future, please give me my name! I will take care of things below the seventh level of Qi training for you." The guard glanced at the storage bag, and when he saw that there were five hundred low-grade spiritual stones in it, he smiled from ear to ear.

"Yes, yes, thank you, Brother Chen Qi. Can I go in first?" Han Lin said with a sorry smile when he saw this.

"Go ahead." Chen Qi waved his hand, sat on the stone bench, picked up the storage bag and looked through it happily.

A moment later, the inner city trade square.

It was still early in the day, but the trade square was still as busy as usual. Han Lin paused slightly and walked towards a shop with a signboard of "Xuan Lian Fang" to the north.

This shop is not as full of goods as other shops. It is more like a tea room to receive guests, and there is not a single person empty.

Han Lin walked in, looked around and shouted, "Is there anyone there?"

As soon as he finished speaking, there was a sound of footsteps in the room next to him, and then, an old man over seventy years old walked out of the side room.

He stared at Han Lin, and when he discovered that Han Lin only had the third level of Qi training, his brows suddenly furrowed, "What's wrong with you?"

"Are you Taoist Fellow Song Yunqi?"
